title: Pierce Brosnan's wife Keely Shaye Smith shares romantic pictures to mark 25-year marriage
text:
Pierce Brosnan's wife Keely Shaye Smith has shared romantic pictures from their 25-year marriage to mark their silver wedding anniversary. The couple, who are often deemed one of Hollywood's greatest love stories, looked more loved-up than ever in a series of photos shared on Instagram.
Pierce Brosnan's wife Keely Shaye Smith has shared romantic pictures from their 25-year marriage to mark their silver wedding anniversary. The couple, who are often deemed one of Hollywood's greatest love stories, looked more loved-up than ever in a series of photos shared on Instagram.
Pierce, 73, and Keely, 62, packed on the PDA as they kissed during a glamorous black tie event before enjoying a romantic stroll on the beach. As they celebrated their 25th wedding anniversary, Keely gushed over their incredible life together. After first meeting in Mexico in 1994, they still looked as happy as ever, as she also shared an up-to-date selfie of the couple in the sunshine. She wrote: 'Happy 25th wedding anniversary my love!
What an adventure life is with you. Looking forward to the next 25 years beside you @piercebrosnanofficial ♥️' Pierce Brosnan's wife Keely Shaye Smith shared some romantic pictures from their 25-year marriage on Instagram to mark their anniversary The couple, who have two sons together, are often deemed one of Hollywood's greatest love stories Pierce and Keely met when he was least expecting to find love - three years after the death of his first wife, Cassandra Harris.
Cassandra, whom he married in 1980, tragically died a day after their 11th wedding anniversary from ovarian cancer at the age of 43. Together, the couple had welcomed son Sean, 41, and the Bond star adopted her children Charlotte - who passed away at 41 after fighting the same disease - and Christopher, 53, from a previous marriage.
'There is an incredible cruelty in it all,' Pierce told People in 1992, 'losing a person you shared everything with. This is the first time in my life I've ever experienced bereavement, and it's overwhelming.
' And it was Keely who helped mend his broken heart. 'Ups and downs are what life is all about,' Pierce explained to The Mail on Sunday in 2013. 'But the memory of Cassie and her fight against cancer is never forgotten. Keely has always been kind and compassionate and encouraged me to mourn Cassie.
' After starring in a few small roles in TV and film throughout the 1980s, Keely transitioned to journalism and documentary film-making. The campaigner grew up in Oahu, Hawaii, and has dedicated much of her work to protecting the oceans surrounding the Pacific island as well as in Mexico. Pierce and Keely first locked eyes in Cabo San Lucas, Mexico, in 1994, where then-TV correspondent Keely had been sent to interview Cheers icon Ted Danson.

What an adventure life is with you.

The pair crossed paths at a party, and sparks soon flew. Upon meeting Pierce, Keely told People that she immediately found the Bond actor 'captivating' and that he had a 'mischievous sparkle in his eyes'.
In the same 2011 interview, the actor said of his wife: 'I found a great woman in Keely Shaye. Not if I searched a million times over would I find one as good.
' Three years after their fateful meeting in Mexico, Keely and Pierce welcomed son Dylan, now 29, in January 1997. He was joined by brother Paris in February 2001, who is now 25. That August, Pierce and Keely tied the knot at Ballintubber Abbey in Ireland and, in true fairy-tale fashion, celebrated at Ashford Castle. Now, 25 years later, they're still going strong.
However, their two-decade marriage has not been without its 'hardships'. Speaking with Fox News in 2023, Pierce endearingly said about Keely and their marriage: 'We like each other a lot. We love each other a lot.
' He continued: 'And we've been down the road, and we've seen many, many hardships as families do, as we all do,' before adding: 'But watching someone grow up with you and grow old with you is a very spiritual journey. ' Pierce has never been shy to compliment his wife in interviews and always defended her against cruel comments from online critics regarding her appearance.
On the secret to a long marriage, Pierce said: 'It's solving one problem after the other, whether it's the washing machine or how far the finances are going to go or what your dreams are' Pierce and Keely are pictured with their sons Dylan and Paris in 201
